payload.acceptance_criteria: - Given a refused commit left files staged when the agent prepares the next commit then the guidance or a gate makes it read git diff --cached --name-only before it commits
payload.description:
## Trigger

When a hook refuses a commit and the agent stages a different change for the next commit, I want the leftover staged files to be seen before the commit, so I can keep each commit to one change.

## Scope

- `.basicly/core/fragments/commands/git-discipline.fragment.yaml`
- `.basicly/core/skills/conventional-commits/skill.yaml`

## Background

In basicly-s75kusg a refused release-summary commit left CHANGELOG.md staged, and the next fix commit took it along (689d218a).
payload.requirements: - Prefer a gate over a note when one can refuse the mixed commit
payload.title: Check the staged set before a commit that follows a refused commit

payload.acceptance_criteria: - Given a manual worktree for a repository with node hooks when the agent follows the worktree-isolation skill then node_modules is copied or provisioned the way basicly loop does, not linked by a relative path
payload.description:
## Trigger

When an agent makes a git worktree by hand and the commit hooks need node_modules, I want the worktree to get a working copy, so I can commit without a hook failure from a link that breaks in the hook's temp tree.

## Scope

- `.basicly/core/skills/worktree-isolation/skill.yaml`

## Background

In basicly-tgenbu5 a relative node_modules link in a manual worktree broke inside the pre-commit staged snapshot and the hook failed with a bare ValueError. basicly loop already copies node_modules when package-lock.json is identical.
payload.requirements: - Reuse the copy that basicly loop already performs
payload.title: Copy node_modules into a manual worktree instead of a relative link
